items.title: Joe Mares Jr. Interview, 1960-04-08
items.q: And then my brother Vic, who's two years younger than myself, was a real good tenor man.

ctx.x: Well, no, he played the Tokyo Gardens out at West End at concerts and stuff. And then my brother Vic, who's two years younger than myself, was a real good tenor man. He took up tenor. In fact, he's got lessons from Skag and Leon. Skag was one of good clarinet players and saxophone men in the late 20s.
Is he the one that played violin too? Did he? No, rap played violin.
